methodNote: Provisional. House fighters scored from in-game renders; entries scored from their own submitted renders (RULES.md §7 says standardised judge renders decide; those replace these scores when the judging harness runs).
rubric: Realism Score /100 = Fighter 70 (skin 15, face/eyes/teeth 20, hair 10, clothing 15, overall 10) + Fight 30 (motion quality 15, contact and reactions 10, grounding 5). See RULES.md §6.

hermes.notes: Best of the house roster: believable armour and cloth, but a game-quality face, gold tint over the textures, and punches that rarely touch the target.

muse.notes: Hair and costume read well at a distance; skin is smooth and stylised up close; the magenta tint is unnatural.

gemini.notes: Clean sci-fi bodysuit, stylised face, no skin micro-detail.

grok.notes: Armour materials are decent; the darkening tint flattens everything; the face reads as a game character.

me.notes: The only real face in the field (photo-textured FaceBuilder head), but low-res and downcast, hair painted on, on a pink plastic mannequin body with a visible neck seam.

claude.notes: A good suit of armour with no human visible inside it; the orange tint makes it look painted.

aaron.notes: Fully masked ninja: decent fabric, but nothing human to judge, so it can't score on skin, face or hair.

entry:grok.notes: Clearly the most human: real pore and stubble detail, believable eyes and lashes, a convincing buzz cut. Flat sculpted training wear, no subsurface look in the skin, and in fighting_idle he balances on his toes, so the feet don't plant.

entry:gemini.notes: A much more natural face (eyeliner and emblem gone, believable brown eyes), but the skin has no visible pores, the neck is long and thin, and the suit is a flat single-colour fill with the original sci-fi panel seams and boots. 46 on the rubric minus 20 for two false claims: the manifest's material values are wrong (skin IOR is 1.38, not 1.40; eye roughness is 0.15, not 0.031; the 'pore normal' is the shared original normal map), and NOTES.md still describes a woven ripstop uniform with bronze-gold straps that isn't in the model.

entry:hermes.notes: The submitted renders don't show a usable fighter: the front render is from inside the model and shows untextured primitive shapes, and the close-up shows only the background. Re-render and resubmit to be judged properly.

entry:claude.notes: Claude's own entry: the owner scores it (RULES.md v2.2). Until then it can't be crowned. Judge renders for the owner are in competition/judging/claude/.

entry:me.notes: A real photo-textured face with visible skin detail, but the eyes are downcast, the hair is painted onto a bald-looking scalp, and there is a ragged seam where the head meets the neck. Below the neck it is the bare pink X Bot mannequin with dark ball joints, so there is no skin, clothing or anatomy to score.
